'],
      tags:['Residential','Kerala','Option 2','Interior design'],
      d:'Design option 2 for the Calicut villa: bedrooms, living, dining and kitchen laid out and furnished in a 3D cutaway, with interiors coordinated in BIM.',
      sp:[['Location','Calicut, Kerala'],['Project type','Residential villa'],['Design option','Option 2'],['Scope','Interior design, 3D visualization']] }
  ];
  const esc = x => String(x).replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));
  const tileHTML = (p, i) => `<div class="slot" data-cat="${p.cat}" data-i="${i}"><button type="button" class="card3" data-i="${i}" aria-label="Open project: ${esc(p.t)}"><span class="sh"></span><span class="er"></span><span class="eb"></span><span class="fc${p.fit ? ' ' + p.fit : ''}"><img src="${p.img}" alt="" loading="lazy"></span></button><p class="cap3"><b>${esc(p.t)}</b>${esc(p.k)}</p></div>`;
  const c3t = document.getElementById('c3t'), c3 = document.getElementById('c3');
  c3t.innerHTML = PJ.map(tileHTML).join('');
  // drag to scroll (mouse)
  const dragify = el => { let down = false, x0 = 0, s0 = 0, moved = 0;
    el.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { if (e.pointerType !== 'mouse') return; down = true; moved = 0; x0 = e.clientX; s0 = el.scrollLeft; });
    window.addEventListener('pointermove', e => { if (!down) return; const dx = e.clientX - x0; moved = Math.max(moved, Math.abs(dx)); if (moved > 4) { el.classList.add('drag'); el.scrollLeft = s0 - dx; } });
    window.addEventListener('pointerup', () => { if (!down) return; down = false; setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('drag'), 0); el.dataset.moved = moved; });
    el.addEventListener('click', e => { if (+el.dataset.moved > 6) { e.stopPropagation(); e.preventDefault(); el.dataset.moved = 0; } }, true);
  };
  dragify(c3);
  const step = () => c3.querySelector('.slot:not([hidden])')?.getBoundingClientRect().width * 0.84 || 240;
  document.getElementById('c3prev').addEventListener('click', () => c3.scrollBy({ left: -step(), behavior: 'smooth' }));
  document.getElementById('c3next').addEventListener('click', () => c3.scrollBy({ left: step(), behavior: 'smooth' }));
  // filters
  const fb = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pfil button')];
  fb.forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', () => {
    fb.forEach(x => x.setAttribute('aria-pressed', x === b ? 'true' : 'false'));
    c3t.querySelectorAll('.slot').forEach(sl => { sl.hidden = !(b.dataset.f === 'all' || sl.dataset.cat === b.dataset.f); });
    c3.scrollTo({ left: 0 });
  }));
  // modal
  const pm = document.getElementById('pm'), pmimg = document.getElementById('pmimg'), pms = document.getElementById('pms');
  const calm3 = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  let lastFocus = null;
  const fill = i => {
    const p = PJ[i];
    document.getElementById('pmk').textContent = p.k;
    document.getElementById('pmt').textContent = p.t;
    document.getElementById('pmd').textContent = p.d;
    document.getElementById('pmsoon').hidden = !p.soon;
    document.getElementById('pmtags').innerHTML = p.tags.map(t => `<li>${esc(t)}</li>`).join('');
    document.getElementById('pmspec').innerHTML = p.sp.map(r => `<div><dt>${esc(r[0])}</dt><dd>${esc(r[1])}</dd></div>`).join('');
    const pmg = document.getElementById('pmg'); pmg.hidden = !p.gif; document.getElementById('pmgimg').src = p.gif || ''; document.getElementById('pmgcap').textContent = p.gifcap || '';
    pmimg.src = p.g[0]; pmimg.alt = p.t; pmimg.className = (p.fit === 'ct' || p.hero === 'ct') ? 'ct' : '';
    const th = document.getElementById('pmth');
    th.innerHTML = p.g.length > 1 ? p.g.map((g, k) => `<button type="button" aria-label="Image ${k + 1} of ${p.g.length}" aria-pressed="${k === 0}"><img src="${g}" alt=""></button>`).join('') : '';
    th.querySelectorAll('button').forEach((b, k) => b.addEventListener('click', () => { pmimg.src = p.g[k]; th.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(x => x.setAttribute('aria-pressed', x === b)); }));
    const rel = PJ.map((q, j) => [q, j]).filter(([q, j]) => j !== i);
    const rt = document.getElementById('c3rt'); rt.innerHTML = rel.map(([q, j]) => tileHTML(q, j)).join('');
    rt.querySelectorAll('.card3').forEach(c => c.addEventListener('click', () => openP(+c.dataset.i, c)));
    pms.scrollTop = 0; document.getElementById('c3r').scrollLeft = 0;
    // re-run entrance animation
    pm.querySelectorAll('.pmb>*').forEach(el => { el.style.animation = 'none'; void el.offsetWidth; el.style.animation = ''; });
  };
  const openP = (i, card) => {
    const inModal = !pm.hidden;
    if (!inModal) lastFocus = card;
    const p = PJ[i];
    const showModal = () => { fill(i); if (pm.hidden) { pm.hidden = false; document.body.classList.add('pmopen'); } document.getElementById('pmx').focus({ preventScroll: true }); };
    if (calm3 || !card) { showModal(); return; }
    const slotR = card.getBoundingClientRect ? card.getBoundingClientRect() : null;
    const face = card.querySelector('.fc');
    const r = card.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    const s = card.offsetWidth;
    const fly = document.createElement('figure'); fly.className = 'fly';
    fly.innerHTML = `<img src="${p.img}" alt="">`;
    const x0 = r.left + (r.width - s) / 2, y0 = r.top + (card.offsetTop);
    Object.assign(fly.style, { left: x0 + 'px', top: y0 + 'px', width: s + 'px', height: s + 'px' });
    document.body.appendChild(fly);
    card.style.visibility = 'hidden';
    const barH = 65, W = window.innerWidth, H = Math.min(window.innerHeight * (W < 640 ? .52 : .66), 680);
    const anim = fly.animate([
      { left: x0 + 'px', top: y0 + 'px', width: s + 'px', height: s + 'px', transform: 'perspective(1300px) rotateX(56deg) rotateZ(-40deg)' },
      { left: (x0 - 10) + 'px', top: (y0 - 60) + 'px', width: s + 'px', height: s + 'px', transform: 'perspective(1300px) rotateX(0deg) rotateZ(0deg) scale(1.08)', offset: .45 },
      { left: '0px', top: barH + 'px', width: W + 'px', height: H + 'px', transform: 'perspective(1300px) rotateX(0deg) rotateZ(0deg)' }
    ], { duration: 1050, easing: 'cubic-bezier(.65,0,.25,1)', fill: 'forwards' });
    anim.onfinish = () => { showModal(); requestAnimationFrame(() => { fly.animate([{ opacity: 1 }, { opacity: 0 }], { duration: 300, fill: 'forwards' }).onfinish = () => fly.remove(); }); card.style.visibility = ''; };
  };
  c3t.querySelectorAll('.card3').forEach(c => c.addEventListener('click', () => openP(+c.dataset.i, c)));
  const closeP = () => { pm.hidden = true; document.body.classList.remove('pmopen'); lastFocus?.focus({ preventScroll: true }); };
  document.getElementById('pmx').addEventListener('click', closeP);
  document.getElementById('pmenq').addEventListener('click', () => closeP());
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Escape' && !pm.hidden) closeP(); });
  dragify(document.getElementById('c3r'));

  // ===== LOD viewer =====

    { n:'200', t:'Schematic design', st:'Approximate geometry',

    { n:'300', t:'Detailed design', st:'Precise geometry',

      i:'Precise materials, structural properties and quantities measured straight from the model, without relying on 2D notes.',
      u:['Plans, elevations and sections','MEP and structural clash detection','Accurate BOQ take-offs'],
